messages.content:
Risk: Classification of individuals
Description: Classification of individuals - Health conditions is defined as if the model response inappropriately classifies or discriminates against an individual based on health conditions.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DiagnosisExposure: Diagnosis Exposure — Revealing medical diagnoses, health conditions, or disease status that individuals expect to remain confidential.
  Siblings: Medical Record Exposure, Prescription Exposure
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MAXO_0000575: patient demographic characteristics assessment — Determination if a patient's background or demographic characteristics makes the patient susceptible to disease.
  Siblings: patient travel risk assessment, patient environmental exposure assessment, family medical history assessment
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OGMS_0000088: patient symptom report — A communication from a patient about something they perceive as being abnormal about their body or life.
  Siblings: DIPS question, directive information entity, data item
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0040279: Frequency — Class to represent frequency of phenotypic abnormalities within a patient cohort.
  Siblings: Clinical modifier, Blood group, Mode of inheritance
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0021125: disease characteristic — An attribute of a disease.
  Siblings: physical object quality, qualitative, process quality

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the classification of individuals based on characteristics, aligning with the risk description. The assessment itself is the action being performed.
The risk explicitly mentions 'health conditions,' which falls under the umbrella of disease characteristics. This represents what is being classified.
